structure_flags.label: bibliography:Andrews2019SingularityRobust
structure_flags.one_line: The cited Quantitative Economics article is by Donald W. K. Andrews and Patrik Guggenberger, not Andrews alone.

soundness_flags.label: ass:entire-mgf
soundness_flags.one_line: It is tagged standard and attributed to Kivva et al., but their Assumption 4 is only a local positive-radius moment-series condition; global real-MGF finiteness is a strict strengthening and must be retagged novel with a regime justification.

soundness_flags.label: ass:positive-profile-dimension; ass:order-cap; ass:calibration-rank; ass:calibration-gap
soundness_flags.one_line: BACKSHIFT studies diagonal covariance-shift profiles and its joint-diagonalization condition, not a latent cumulant-profile dimension, a d+2 cumulant cap, or rank/singular-value conditions on the proposed C matrix; retag these as model-specific assumptions and cite appropriate linear-algebra support for stability.

soundness_flags.label: ass:treatment-loading-bound; ass:confounding-bound
soundness_flags.one_line: Kivva et al.'s published assumptions do not impose the asserted compact loading or uniform confounding-ratio bounds; these are useful new uniformity restrictions but are not standard conditions under the supplied citation.

soundness_flags.label: ass:moment-envelope
soundness_flags.one_line: Andrews and Guggenberger impose high-level moments on supplied moment functions and derivatives, not this source-level 2Rmax+delta envelope for cumulant U-statistics; retain it as a justified sufficient condition or replace the citation.

soundness_flags.label: thm:identification-frontier; def:no-breakout-branch
soundness_flags.one_line: The prose calls absence of a flag an exact ambiguity branch, but no condition or to-prove witness establishes that N_rho is nonempty: the declared bounds need not contain alpha=1 and its source-swapped image, so the converse branch can be empty.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: honest_scope: source-labelled domain D_rho
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The claimed iff frontier is conditional on the explicitly source-labelled union D_rho, rather than arbitrary simultaneous environmental shifts.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Identification, ambiguity, and interval-length claims are interpreted only over D_rho.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: honest_scope: ass:entire-mgf
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Global finiteness of every source MGF is assumed, not derived from the cited local analytic-moment framework.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: All population frontier and sharpness claims are conditional on this narrower globally moment-determinate source regime.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add a fixed-bounds, explicit no-breakout source-swap witness and state simple feasibility inequalities (in particular, alpha=1 and its swapped effect/loading must lie in the rho-interior); this makes the converse side of the claimed iff frontier nonvacuous.

Retag the four citation-mismatched assumption groups as novel or replace them with sources supporting their exact formulations; give a concrete experimental mechanism for when the global-MGF and profile-plane restrictions hold together.

Promote the Poisson finite-difference handle into a worked d=1, E=3, prescribed-r instance computing C, Q_A, r-star, and the matched lower observed moments; it would make both sharpness theorems independently auditable.

recommended_next_step: Revise the assumption taxonomy/citations and add a nonempty legal no-breakout witness under explicit bound-feasibility conditions, then advance the field-tier exact-identification kernel to Stage 0.
